lessons.keep: Keep one product constant while showing related agent capabilities.
lessons.avoid: Avoid presenting rising charts and revenue forecasts as verified outcomes.
lessons.open: Store execution, test validity, conversion gains, transactions, source rights and audio delivery remain unverified.
